components.css: :host{--ink:#16181d;--ink-2:#4f5562;--line:#e2e4e9;--line-strong:#c9ccd3;--soft:#f6f7f9;--bg:#ffffff;--filed:#17614f;--filed-bg:#e8f3ef;--held:#8a4b00;--held-bg:#fbf1e1;--focus:#2f5bd3;--radius:8px;--sans:"Geist",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;--mono:"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,monospace} .ds-steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:16px 20px 4px;counter-reset:s;font-family:var(--sans)}.ds-steps li{position:relative;padding:0 0 10px 36px;counter-increment:s}.ds-steps li::before{content:counter(s);position:absolute;left:0;top:1px;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:0.8125rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-2);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line-strong);background:var(--bg)}.ds-steps li::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:10.5px;top:28px;bottom:6px;width:1px;background:var(--line)}.ds-steps li:last-child::after{display:none}.ds-steps h3{margin:0;font-size:0.9375rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:var(--ink)}.ds-steps p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:0.875rem;color:var(--ink-2)}.ds-steps li.done::before{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;box-shadow:none}.ds-steps[data-outcome="filed"] li.done::before{background:var(--filed)}.ds-steps li.pending h3{color:#6b717c}.ds-steps li.pending p{visibility:hidden}.ds-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:0.8125rem;color:var(--ink)}

narrative.overview:
A plain product page whose craft is exactness. White ground, near-black ink, hairline rules, and one working demo that carries the page; every figure on screen is the recorded one. The world refuses the AI-startup look: no split hero with a glowing screenshot, no gradient text, no logo row. Character comes from spacing, a tight Geist ramp, and the honesty of the data, not from ornament.

Colour is spent on meaning. Deep green means "filed", amber-brown means "waits for a person", and those two hues appear only where a decision is shown. Everything else is ink on white, separated by 1px lines. Geist Mono marks what the pipeline read or produced (document text, unit ids, scores), so a visitor can tell machine output from explanation at a glance.

Motion is a replay, not decoration: choosing a document plays the four steps in order, each revealing its real data, and reduced motion shows the final state at once.

This system covers the public front page (`web/public/home/`) and the reviewer page served at `/reviewer` (the token form in `web/login.html` and the review app under `web/src`). The front page is the Persuade surface; the reviewer page is the Operate surface, where the same world shows up as plain, dense, scannable working UI.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, near-black ink, two outcome colours used only for outcomes.
1px hairline rules do the structural work that cards and shadows do elsewhere.
Geist for language, Geist Mono for pipeline data.
One raised object per page: the demo panel.
Real numbers, tabular figures, plain words; research terms live behind a fold.

rules.name: The Outcome-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green and amber appear only where Docket shows a decision. They never decorate headings, links, icons or charts.

rules.name: The Waiting-Is-Correct Rule
rules.body: Held Amber is a calm, earthy tone, never an alarm red. Holding a document for a person is shown as a safe outcome, not an error.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for data the pipeline read or produced: document text, unit ids, scores, file names. Fixed settings such as the clue weights, explanation, labels and headings are always Geist, with tabular figures where numbers line up.

rules.name: The Bold Figure Rule
rules.body: In running text, emphasis goes on the number or the condition that matters ("28 of 28", "at least two different clues"), set in 600 Ledger Ink against Second Ink prose. No italics, no colour emphasis.

rules.name: The One Raised Object Rule
rules.body: A page has at most one lifted surface, and it is the thing the visitor operates. Everything else sits flat on hairlines.

dos: **Do** take every figure from the recorded data and bold the figure, not the claim around it.
**Do** use Filed Green and Held Amber only for a decision, and show who decided (rules, model, person) beside it.
**Do** set pipeline output (document text, unit ids, scores) in Geist Mono at 13px; everything else, fixed settings included, in Geist.
**Do** separate content with 1px hairlines and the Soft Grey recess before reaching for a box or a shadow.
**Do** keep the 8px radius for the operated panel and buttons; leave everything else square.
**Do** give every animated step a static, readable final state, shown at once under reduced motion.
**Do** use the shared focus ring (2px Focus Blue, 3px offset) on every interactive element.
donts: **Don't** use gradients, gradient text, glows or coloured shadows.
**Don't** add a split hero with a glowing product screenshot, a logo row, testimonials or invented customers.
**Don't** lift more than one surface per page with the panel shadow.
**Don't** colour a held document red or style it as an error.
**Don't** reuse the dashed border for anything but a labelled, not-yet-built slot.
**Don't** apply this system's look to the reviewer page piecemeal; it joins the world in its own restyle phase.
